name: github-actions-ci-fix

en.description: Diagnose and repair failing GitHub Actions checks on a pull request using gh metadata and logs, a focused root-cause plan, approval before code changes, and post-fix verification.

zh-CN.description: 根据 GitHub Actions 日志定位失败根因，在确认后实施最小修复并重新验证检查结果。

stableBlockers: Exercise script against failed, pending, and external checks
Measure root-cause precision on real CI failures
Validate GitHub CLI field drift in CI
